plugin.name: LOOPGENOME
plugin.description: Drums and neuro bass learned as one loop; one Pinball ball picks the drum slice and the bass articulation

Walk: Reset the ball (to the start step)
Inputs: Halt (trigger: the ball stops until the next reset)
Root (V/oct: the bass's key, folded to the sub's octave)
Outputs: Step (the ball's step, 0-10 V over the loop)
